description: This file provides extension methods for the HttpContext class to access a correlation ID processed by CorrelationIdMiddleware. It specifically defines a method GetCorrelationId that retrieves the correlation ID from HttpContext items or falls back to TraceIdentifier.

classes.name: CorrelationIdHttpContextExtensions
classes.description: A static class offering extension methods for HttpContext to access correlation IDs associated with requests.

methods.name: GetCorrelationId
methods.description: Retrieves the current request's correlation ID set by CorrelationIdMiddleware, or defaults to HttpContext.TraceIdentifier if not set.
